parent_v2_2.rule: v2.2 is immutable; v2.3 only adds independent M evidence

scientific_question: Does direct source-conditioned movement evidence resolve the BAM-state ambiguity that remains after complete G, perfect negatives, occupied-node arrival timing, and direct A/B observations?
evidence_ladder: E4 = v2.2 complete G + perfect negatives + occupied-node arrival + complete A + complete B
E5 = E4 + complete direct M accessibility over all nodes
E6 = E5 + complete direct first-arrival state over all nodes

direct_M_semantics.accessibility: Independent observation that a node is reachable from the declared source under the movement process, irrespective of A, B, or realised occupancy.
direct_M_semantics.arrival: Independent movement-state observation returning exact first-arrival step, or inaccessible, for each node.
direct_M_semantics.examples: Idealised analogues include controlled translocation, telemetry, dispersal tracking, or known movement-network experiments; this simulation does not claim real datasets provide perfect M observations.

primary_hypotheses.claim: Complete direct M-accessibility observations eliminate every E4-compatible BAM state whose M set differs from truth.
primary_hypotheses.failure_rule: Any M-mismatched BAM state surviving E5 refutes H1.

primary_hypotheses.claim: Complete direct first-arrival observations eliminate every E5-compatible BAM state whose movement-arrival vector differs from truth.
primary_hypotheses.failure_rule: Any arrival-mismatched BAM state surviving E6 refutes H2.

primary_hypotheses.claim: E6 collapses the compatible set to the exact truth BAM-state equivalence class for every eligible truth.
primary_hypotheses.failure_rule: Any non-equivalent BAM state surviving E6 refutes H3.

primary_hypotheses.claim: Worlds with identical A, B, M and arrival state remain unresolved parameter aliases even after E6.
primary_hypotheses.failure_rule: Splitting an exact BAM-state alias class refutes H4.

primary_hypotheses.claim: A deterministic finite set of diagnostic M-state node observations can reproduce the complete E6 BAM-state contraction.
primary_hypotheses.failure_rule: Any case where targeted observations fail to reproduce E6 refutes H5; required measurement count is reported without thresholding.

forbidden_after_results: drop exact BAM-state aliases from the compatible set
treat perfect M observations as automatically available in real data
